title: Armadillo Armor
description: Adds the Armadillo armor piece to the game! The Turtle Shell helmet finally has an Armadillo Shell chestplate counterpart! Use 8 armadillo scutes to craft a special chestplate that grants +7 armor and poison immunity, allowing for more diverse playstyles.
body:
Are you tired of getting poisoned by pesky cave spiders, witches, pufferfish and the occasional snack on a spider eye or poisonous potato? Maybe you're looking to have a matching outfit with your pet wolf? Or maybe you're tired of the classic armor types and are just looking for more scute-based armor to compliment your Turtle Shell helmet? If any of this sounds familiar, then Armadillo Armor is the pack for you! 

Use 8 armadillo scutes to craft the Armadillo Shell chestplate, providing the player with +7 armor and poison immunity when worn! While wearing the Armadillo Shell, any would-be poison effect gets converted into an instant health effect (at a cost of about ~10 durability damage). At 400 durability points, this means that a player can be healed by poison up to 40 times in the lifespan of one Armadillo Shell, providing a unique and practical armor alternative that diversifies options for playstyles! 

The pack also comes with a couple extra advancements for crafting the armor and for having matching outfits with your pet wolf! 

Future plans for the pack involve adding a "curl" ability for temporarily increased resistance but balanced with slowness, blindness, and weakness. Other possible features to-be include adding more fun advancements, expanding both scute armor sets entirely, adding scute-based shields, adding unique armor pieces for other one-off items in the game. Future updates are on the way! (Optifine Support in-progress, needs testing once OF 1.21 version is released).

NOTE: Don't forget to download the required Resource Pack from the Download page as well!
